sentences.text: Coracias chauvireae was described as a new species in 2026 by N. Zelenkov based on a tarsometatarsus bone recovered from the Early Pleistocene Taurida Cave in central Crimea.
The fossil originates from the Pleistocene epoch and has been recovered only from sites in Crimea.
When first reported, the taxon was formally designated as sp. nov, indicating a newly recognized species.
Current assessments regard the taxonomic status of Coracias chauvireae as valid.
The bird belongs to the family Coraciidae, the rollers, and is placed within the genus Coracias.
It provides the earliest known fossil record of the genus Coracias in Eurasia.
